batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b Z Khan

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b J Yadav

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c S Nadeem b Z Khan

batting.name: DJ Bravo
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b GS Sandhu

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c R Ashwin b IC Pandey

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b P Negi

batting.name: JA Morkel
batting.dismissal: c IC Pandey b P Negi

balls.text: fired full and outside off, Negi steps out, edges it to the left of the keeper. Qdk gets a glove, keeping it to one
dug in shortish and outside off, dragged to mid-on. Just a single
shortish and swerves in, beats Jadeja's inside edge. Jaddu had no clue about this
dug in shortish and outside off, suspect that was a slower ball, flat-batted to the off-side sweeper
yorker outside leg, jabbed through the covers
Negi backs away, Sandhu follows him. Tapped to backward point
yorker hurled at the base of leg, he can't jam it out. Off the pad and they sneak one. Top bowling effort from Zaheer: 4-1-9-2. 19 dots!
lifter outside off, Negi seeks to pull and can't connect. One for the over says the umpire
mighty full and outside off, Negi backs away. Misses the slice
low full toss on off, bunted down to long-on. They race across for two
slower ball on off, he pulls all the pace off it again. dabbed behind point

Dhoni holes out to Nadeem! Fuller length and around off, stops on Dhoni. Change-up. He steps away a bit and mishits it high in the air. Nadeem runs in from long-off and snaffles the take before tumbling onto the ground
short on middle, tucks up Negi for room. Blocked back to the bowler
Dhoni nips down the track, slower ball. Dragged to long-on
Dhoni nails the pull now. Another short ball, Dhoni quick to rock onto the back foot and pull it over backward square leg, one-bounce four

Another catch for JP Duminy. Zaheer is in Sandhu's ears. Banged in shortish and hurries on outside off, Bravo wants to slog it away, only manages a thick top-edge to Duminy. Good, overhead catch at mid-off
slower ball outside off, DJ is early into the slog and misses
just clears long-on. Full toss around off, Bravo's head falls over. He loses his balance and hoists it over Nadeem. Into the CSK dug out
fired on off, Dhoni uses his feet and nudges it gently through midwicket. No real power. Bravo hustles across for the second
precise placement. Darted outside off, back-cut away in the gap between short third man and backward point
slider outside off, Dhoni was looking to advance. He eventually lets it pass
Dhoni connects one, finally. Full and slid through on middle, Dhoni races down the track and smashes it over the bowler's head. Into the orbit...
on the leg stump, off the pad and rolls to leg
pushed through outside off, goes straight on and beats Bravo's attempted dink towards third man
pitched up and outside off, driven in the air. Sliced in front of Zaheer at mid-off. A little fumble there, but no harm done for the 'hosts'
back of a length and outside off, flashy drive to the covers
MS Dhoni comes down the track, Morkel bangs it short. Mishit over the bowler's head
back of a length and outside of, pushed down to mid-off

dragged on! Morkel gets rid of Faf. This was on a length and on off, keeps a bit low. Faf seeks to dab it down towards third man, does not get hold of it. He gets an inside edge onto middle and off. Faf goes down on his haunches, he has to drag himself off the field
back of a length and outside off. Faf swipes and gets beaten
looped up outside off, Yuvraj held this one back. Checks the lofted-drive and chips it over the covers
fired down leg, poor ball. Eased away past the man at 45. He used the pace of the bowler to good effect
back of a length on middle, Faf goes on the back foot and chops to the covers
leg-stumpish ball, off the pad to short fine leg
darted short on middle, Dhoni can't flick it away. Defends, the ball rolls back
flatter and quicker on leg, whipped through midwicket
banged in short and rises on off, he opens the face of the bat and glides it to deep third man
dragged short and aimed at the body, pulled, dragged to the right of short midwicket. Yadav hunts it down in the deep
slower cutter outside off, dabbed to the right of the keeper. The pair sneak in a couple. Good urgency between the wickets
banged in short and hurries onto Dhoni, who plays a reasonably controlled pull to deep midwicket
veering down leg, Dhoni misses the glance, the diving keeper is beaten as well.
leg-stump ball, helped to long leg
shortish and Yuvraj gets some turn, cramping Faf for room. Turned to leg
pushed through on off, Dhoni advances and flat-bats it to long-off
down the track and worked through midwicket
quicker on off, chopped to point
shortish and outside off, turning ball, spinning away outside off flat-batted to long-off
flat and fired on the stumps, jabbed to long-on
Dhoni steps out, he shortens his length. The batsman can't connect with the drive, takes it on the pad and retreats. The ball lobs in front of Yadav
not middled, but no problem! Length ball, Dhoni skips down the track and hacks it between deep midwicket and long-on. Just evades the one at deep midwicket
darted on off, pushed to the covers off the back foot
quick offie, keeps alarmingly low. Faf stoops low with it and flicks it tentatively through midwicket
down the track and dragged to long-on
flatter and quicker outside off, Faf camps back and punches it to long-on
134ks length ball on off, knocked in front of point for one
fuller and around off, Dhoni shuffles across, takes a step forward and flicks it in front of square on the leg side
shortish and zips through outside off. Dhoni looks to force the pace, advances, swings and misses
short and cramps Faf for room, pulled to the right of short midwicket
on a length and on middle, Faf nips down the track an check-drives it in the air, places it to the right of Duminy, who was diving to his right from mid-off
pitched up just a shade outside off, pressed to point
much quicker through the air, Dhoni looks to defend. Off the pad, the ball lobs to the leg side
darted flat on off, blocked back
big offie spins in from outside off, Dhoni manages an inside edge onto the thigh
offbreak on a length, bunted behind square leg

Raina picks out short cover. Pushed through on middle at 88ks, Raina comes down the track and chips it straight down the throat of the fielder. Duminy helps himself to another catch. Raina shakes his head as he trudges back
pushed in front of point for one

dug in shortish and on the nips, Morkel does not pose a threat, he does not have enough pace. And Raina would have played him a million times in the nets. Pulled convincingly behind square leg. No chance for both long leg and deep midwicket
shortish and rises on the stumps, Raina advances and carves it over backward point to deep third man. The pair hustle across for a couple
on a length and nips away outside off with some extra lift. Zips past the outer edge, leaving Raina prodding and missing
fuller and straight, tucked away through midwicket

fullish and nips in on off, Faf gets forward and drives it to mid-on. Tiwary runs across, bends lazily and lets the ball through him. Lax fielding. Morkel is not pleased with the effort. The ball runs away to the boundary

and he strikes first ball! Smith out for 18 off 24. This was pitched up and swerves in, Smith hangs on the back foot, does not meet with the defensive push, rapped on the back pad in front of middle. The forefinger goes up, both CSK openers back in the hut.
slower lifter on off, Smith can't manufacture his own pace. Pulled backward of square leg
shortish and outside off, he hops up and works it to the left of the bowler, in front of mid-on
shortish on middle, Raina rises with it half-paddles and half-pulls behind square leg
back of a length, flicked away behind square
shortish and down leg - stray ball - helped away to the left of the keeper. Fine on the leg side

Raina opens the face of the bat on impact with this length ball outside off and glides it to deep third man. Raina is halfway down for the second. Smith slips and Raina turns back. He dives and is safe. Yuvraj misses the direct hit
spins in quick on the pads at 100ks, Smith hangs back and wears it on the back pad. Snaking down leg. Nadeem has bowled out: 4-1-18-0.
quicker and flatter on off, he stays back and punches it back to the bowler
tossed up and outside off, Smith flexes his muscles and clobbers it over long-on
picked away off the pads in front of square. Raina off the mark
back of a length on off, punched into the gap at the covers
full and attacking off, poked to short cover

End of a scratchy little knock from Baz, wicket maiden from Zaheer. Baz flits around in the crease, shuffles across off. Zaheer pushes it fuller and outside off, scooped into the hands of JP Duminy at mid-off, takes it in front of his chin. Soft as wax.
too full and outside off, Baz uses his fast hands, flays it straight to point
back of a length, width on offer, slashed to backward point
Baz runs down the track, Zaheer pushes it full and outside off. Baz misses it again. Not sure if that was a slower one
on a length and outside off, Baz wants to help it away over the keeper with his patented reverse scoop after shuffling across off. Only meets with thin air
back of a length and moving away just a shade outside off, quelled in front of gully with an open face
6000 T20 runs for Baz. Darted shortish and outside leg, he steps down the track and drags it to long-on off the inner part of the bat
fired on middle, Baz sinks to one knee and loses his balance. Mistimed sweep to square leg
back of a length on middle, Baz skips away outside leg again, pushes to point
Baz makes room outside leg, Nadeem follows him, mishit slog-sweep towards cow corner
full and on the pads, clipped through midwicket
Baz steps away outside leg, Nadeem slips in a straight ball, which is chipped over the bowler. He wanted to loft it forcefully but did not get enough power
fullish and moves away outside off, Smith has a lazy waft and the ball skims past the outside edge
inswinger from Zaheer, Smith does not move his feet and gets away with an inside edge onto the pad
shortish and directed at the body at 135ks, Smith has ample time to rock back and short-arm pull it away behind square leg. He had rolled his wrists on it to keep it down
back of a length and on a fourth-stump line, defended punchily to mid-off. 0 off 11
back of a length and swerves in, defended off the back foot
Baz runs down the track, Zaheer drags his length back outside off. Lashed over the covers. Off the bottom of the bat, not middled
pushed through on middle and leg, whisked in front of midwicket for one
Baz looks to make room outside leg, Nadeem follows him with an arm-ball. Kept out
straight roller on off, pushed to mid-off
Baz gets his bearings right.. Half-tracker on middle, he swivels on the back foot and pulls it firmly over midwicket
slid through shorter as Nadeem sees Baz skip out, chopped to the covers
looped up on off, Baz seeks to flick to leg and manages an inside edge onto the pad. The ball rolls to off
on a back of a length and outside off, patted to the covers
inducker from Zaheer Khan, Smith was perhaps anticipating an away-going ball. He hangs back and gets an inside edge onto the thigh
good length and curling away, dabbed in front of point with soft hands

fullish and angling away outside off, Baz plays away from the body and gets a thick outer edge that dies in front of gully. Iyer flings to his left and stops the ball. He recovers, gets on his feet and misses the direct hit. Had he nailed the stumps down, Smith would have been out
fuller and around off, blocked back to the bowler
pitched up on off, stops on Baz. He stays in the crease and check-taps it towards mid-off after yanking his bottom hand off the bat
spins in quickly, poked to leg off an inner edge
flighted and spins away, blocked to off
seam-up ball outside off, chopped to point
arm-ball, arrows in with the angle with extra bounce. Smith camps back and takes it on the pad
straighter one on off, poked to the covers
tossed up and just outside off, forward and pushed to the covers
on a length and on middle and leg, punched down to long-on. Delhi Daredevils have some crumbs of comfort. First win for DD over CSK after seven straight defeats
flighted outside off and spins away, Iyer is dragged forward and beaten. He loses his balance, Dhoni didn't collect the ball cleanly, fluffing a stumping opportunity
full and flat on off, he takes it from there and swings it away to the right of long-on. Beats the fielder
fullish and on off, nudged in front of square on the leg side
Morkel gives it away now. Fuller on a leg-stump line, he backs away, comes down and goes for a big hit. Only slices it off the bottom of the bat to Pandey at long-off
Morkel has mauled that! Length and outside off, he dances down the track and launches it over long-on
leg-stump line, turned through midwicket
squirted to the leg side off an inner edge
dragged shortish again, Iyer goes for the pull again, gets it over a leaping Faf. Then bisects deep midwicket and long-on
just evades Faf at short midwicket. Dropped short on middle, he goes deep in the crease and pulls it past the fielder
flatter and quicker, stays low, at the base of off, kept out
straight roller on middle, Morkel gets an inner edge onto the pad and negates the lbw appeal. Oh wait, that was pad first, but would have missed leg maybe
darted outside off, chopped hard into the ground behind point
veering onto the pads, nudged to the right of short midwicket
flatter and on middle, pushed to the covers for one
pushed through on middle and leg, blocked to mid-on
slider on off, Iyer backs away and cuts it to point
drifts on the pads, worked in front of square leg
full toss, bunted down to long-on
quicker and spins away, chopped to point
Mohit makes no mistake now! Yuvraj gone. Pushed through and spins in, he goes low for a slog sweep, does not get hold of it. Mishits it to deep midwicket
pitched up on off, driven through the covers with an open face
much quicker through the air, flatter, dragged to long-on
fifty for Iyer. Spins in on the pads, nudged through square leg for a couple

big offbreak spins in from outside off, he backs away and chops it to the covers. Yuvraj is halfway down the track. Jaddu throws at the strikers'. He should have thrown it to the non-strikers'. Yuvraj would have been in trouble
straying on the pads, tucked away through midwicket
Boom goes Yuvraj. Fullish and on the stumps, he flits down the track and sends it clattering over long-on. Easily clears the fielder
full and outside off, drilled to Baz at covers
angled in on middle, blocked to the leg side
extra bounce outside off, pushed to the covers
slid through flat and quick outside off, cut away behind point. Easily beats a stiff-looking Ashwin, who was giving a chase
drifts in on middle and leg, eased to long leg
drifting onto the pads, helped away to deep backward square leg with a controlled sweep
full and on middle, hacked to long-on off the inner part of the bat
hurrying ball on middle, punched out towards cow corner
picked away off the pads to backward square leg
quick on middle, he backs away and chops it to short third man
length on middle, Iyer shuffles across and AB de Villiers it away over Baz at leg-slip. Nice, little scoop
flat and on a fourth-stump line, punched back to Raina
fullish on the leg stump, bunted to long-on
punched down to long-on for one
skiddy ball on off, pushed back to Jaddu
fuller and on middle and leg, worked to short midwicket
on the pads, nudged to short fine leg, straight to the man there
pushed down leg at 95ks, Yuvi goes low for a sweep, gets a glove on it to the right of Dhoni. Beats short fine leg
flighted and outside off, driven to long-off
slower through the air and full on off, tapped to backward point with an open face
flatter and quicker outside off, turns away. Cracked away past backward point

Mohit puts down a steepler. This was tossed up and outside of, Iyer comes down the track and slogs it with no power. The bat twists in his hand. Mohit did not run quick enough to his left from deep midwicket. Dives and drops it
quicker on middle and leg, Yuvraj sinks to one knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side
full on middle, pushed back to the bowler
looped up on middle and rips away past the outer edge. Sharp turn
flighted and full on middle, blocked to the leg side
slid through on off, punched past a diving Jadeja to long-on
skiddy ball on off, flicked to midwicket
flat on middle and leg, squirted to long leg off an inner edge
quicker on middle, gets an inside edge in front of square on the leg side
slower ball, picked up and dispatched. Full and outside off, Yuvi waits on it and lifts it over mid-off
length and outside off, steered to third man
swinging in on the pads, poor line and Iyer tucks it away through midwicket. Nifty wristwork, no power
pitched further up and outside off, Iyer now makes some room and launches it over the covers. Crackin' hit, inside out
on a length and outside off, Yuvi wants to drive with no feet movement, has to settle with an inside snick towards fine leg
Yuvraj breaks the shackles. Back of a length and around off, he backs away, manufactures his own room and carves it past point
picked away off the pads to Bravo at square leg
on a length on off, pushed back
looped up and turns in on off with extra bounce. He may have got an inside edge onto the pad
slid through on off, whisked to midwicket
loopy offbreak on off, blocked off the front foot
quicker on the pads, worked away, the ball bounces in front of Raina at leg-slip and sneaks away to his right
dug in short and rises outside off, diffused in front of the covers
very full and stays low. Yuvraj stays back and keeps it out
back of a length and lifts outside off, Yuvraj shoulders arms
fuller and slanting away with the angle, left alone
very full and on middle and leg, clipped to mid-on
played on! Fuller and on off at 135ks, keeps alarmingly low. Duminy perhaps seeks to cut and chops it onto the ground. The ball bounces over and rattles off. Too close to play the shot
fuller and on middle and leg, firm-handed push to mid-on again
wide line outside off, Duminy waits on it before guiding it to third man again
on a length and swerves in, pushed to the right of mid-on. Ashwin gets across and limits it to one
on a length and outside off, dabbed to third man
back of a length and outside off, he stands tall and balanced as he punches it past point. Nice way to get off the mark
fullish outside off with a hint of away movement, squirted to third man with an open face
back of a length on off, pushed defensively back to the bowler. CSK: 16/1 in 6. DD:16/1 in 3
on a length and angling away outside, extra bounce off the deck. Duminy chases and misses
on a length and outside off, ignored
Qdk finds Ashwin at long leg. Fractionally short on middle, he picks it up from there and plays it straight to the fielder. He could have placed that better... There it is, the early wicket
dug in shortish and outside off, Iyer slashes and gets a thick outside edge that flies in the air.... Dies in front of Ashwin at third man
fuller and outside off, Qdk shuffles across and helps it to third man
pitched up and outside off, he strides forward and drives it to the left of the covers. Not well-timed but he hit the gap there
beaten soundly! On a good length and largely straightens outside off, he pokes with his feet paralysed to the crease and the ball whizzes past the outer edge
back of a length, top-of-off line, pushed in front of point
flashed to the right of Ishwar to deep third man. On a length and outside off, Iyer throws his bat at it and kitchen-sinks it away
back of a length and on middle, clipped to mid-on for one
shortish and just a shade outside off, tucks up QdK for room, blocked back to the bowler
lifter outside off, Iyer yanks his head out of the way
dug in shortish and outside off, he rides the bounce and late-cuts it behind point, beats Ashwin's slide at deep third
back of a length on middle, turned to leg
fractionally short and outside off, dragged to Ashwin at long leg off the inner part of the bat
back of a length and on a fourth stump line, holds up in the pitch, blocked back to the bowler
full and on middle, driven to Bravo at mid-on
